dataHandling.portfolioAndApiKeys: portfolio stays browser-local; API keys stay in browser storage and are transmitted only to the selected provider or an explicitly configured Worker for the requested call
dataHandling.publicData: Pages receives bounded snapshots, research references, and content-addressed web projections only; canonical bulk ledgers remain producer-side until retention-managed object storage is configured; do not place secrets or personal data in either plane

deploymentContract: The Pages workflow stages this allowlist minus the explicit bulk exclusions; a root checkout is not itself a public artifact.

bulkDataBoundary.pagesRole: bounded projections and immutable digest-addressed web objects
bulkDataBoundary.futureStoreRole: complete 13F rows, PIT observations, large histories, retention-managed raw and replay artifacts
